body: The release guide says the supported export contains only exact matches, but the native reviewed baseline contains 1737 exact and 2 scientifically supported broad rows (melezitose monohydrate and sodium perchlorate monohydrate). Correct the prose to describe scientifically supported rows with their reviewed predicates; do not change the predicate or scientific gates. Discovered during the independent KG-Microbe unmapped-chemical review.
title: Describe reviewed broad mappings accurately in the SSSOM release guide
